name: Creation editor
description: Add a creation (a file, a link or text) or edit one of the learner's own (DBU-09): title, kind (first guessed from the file, link or text, and changeable), made with, a description and "I've used it in class". A creation from a hand-in, or one holding its own file, keeps what it holds: only its words change. Delete asks first and never touches the hand-in. saveCreation and deleteCreation do the work.
